title: Bleak House

vibeProfile.oneLine: A ruinous lawsuit and a buried secret, in Dickens's most ambitious novel.

summary: An endless lawsuit, Jarndyce and Jarndyce, grinds through the fog-bound Court of Chancery, entangling a huge cast whose fates turn on a long-buried secret. Alternating between a cool narrator and the warm voice of the orphan Esther Summerson, Dickens builds his most ambitious novel: part mystery, part fierce satire of a legal system that devours the people it claims to serve. Dense, brilliant and structurally daring, it is widely considered his greatest work.
whyReadIt: Often called Dickens's greatest, a foggy mystery and a savage satire of the law. Dense, ambitious and stunningly built.

funFacts.text: Its portrait of the Court of Chancery is one of literature's great attacks on legal delay.
